bio: As you admire the mural depicting Piazza del Campo in Sienna and the patio to the rear, you may almost forget you’re in Brussels’ Louise district. Dolce Amaro is a 100% authentic, bustling Italian trattoria. The food is equally genuine: orecchiette al dente in an aroma-packed tomato sauce and juicy chunks of pork or super-fresh seabass exquisitely paired with melt-in-the-mouth aubergine… Outstanding flavours that will knock the socks off your tastebuds. Let’s not forget the wine list, an Aladdin’s Cave of Italian tipples....
